description: Tests for records with missing or empty required fields. Robustness category G.

fixtures.input_condition: Record with empty text field (empty string)
fixtures.expected_behavior: Pipeline processes record without crash. Zero entities extracted from empty text. Record appears in ingested record count.
fixtures.rationale: RuleBasedNER returns empty list for empty text. Extract_entities handles the empty case without exception.

fixtures.input_condition: Record with missing date field (empty string date)

source_records.text: TEST FIXTURE: Subject Theta observed at Test Location E.

fixtures.expected_behavior: Pipeline processes record without crash. Empty date propagates to edges. Co-occurrence edge has date='' which does not cause anomaly detection to fail.
fixtures.rationale: The pipeline passes date as a string field. Empty string is valid for the dataclass and does not cause a crash. Anomaly detection may skip this record in temporal analysis.

fixtures.input_condition: Record with missing source field (defaults to 'unknown')

source_records.text: TEST FIXTURE: Subject Iota observed at Test Location F with vehicle TF02BB0002.

fixtures.expected_behavior: JSONFileConnector defaults source to 'unknown' if key missing. Empty source string passes through. Does not cause crash.
fixtures.rationale: JSONFileConnector uses row.get('source', 'unknown'). Empty string source is valid at the Record dataclass level.
